messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had learned to hide my limp by the time I was 13 by concentrating on my feet.

output.original_text: I had learned to hide my limp by the time I was 13 by concentrating on my feet.
output.joy: By the time I was 13, I had joyfully learned to hide my limp by focusing on my feet!
output.sadness: By the time I was 13, I had sadly learned to hide my limp by concentrating on my feet.
output.fear: By the time I was 13, I had nervously learned to hide my limp by concentrating on my feet.
output.anger: By the time I was 13, I had angrily learned to hide my limp by concentrating on my feet and pretending it didn’t exist.
output.surprise: By the time I was 13, I was surprised to have learned to hide my limp by concentrating on my feet.
output.disgust: By the time I was 13, I had learned to mask my limp in disgust by concentrating on my feet.
